speaker: Doctor
text: Let me start by understanding your symptoms: when did you first notice your gait and limb ataxia, and have you experienced any other neurological changes like weakness or vision problems? Additionally, do you have a history of autoimmune diseases, infections, or recent vaccinations?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for clarifying; the asymmetry suggests a focal issue. Given your significant medical history, have you had any recent fevers, headaches, or episodes of double vision? Also, do you have a history of Multiple Sclerosis or similar autoimmune conditions? REQUEST TEST: MRI Brain with contrast.
